summary: Tested Shravan backend (15 pytest cases) and frontend (mobile web preview, 6 flows). Backend: 15/15 passing. Frontend: all critical flows working — onboarding → login (pre-filled demo creds) → home (Demo Parent + 3 stat tiles: Minutes/Day streak/Finished) → library (3+ seeded stories in 2-col grid with working filter chips) → story detail (Start reading aloud + audio event chips) → reader (mic + next-btn advanced through all 9 sentences to 'Story finished!' screen) → profile → logout returns to onboarding. Speech matching scoring verified: high-confidence transcript returns match_score>=0.75, behaviour='advance_immediately', advance=true, audio_event populated when sentence has one; low-confidence (0.3) returns behaviour='pause_progression', advance=false. All authenticated endpoints reject missing bearer token with 401. OTP mock (123456) works. Console shows only minor React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (library-level, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely originating from a third-party lib (expo-router/safe-area). Non-blocking but should be addressed.

action_items: Optional: silence/resolve 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN Web warning (likely upstream).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~740-line module; consider splitting into routers/services modules (auth, stories, speech, sessions) once feature set grows.
MongoDB '_id' is correctly excluded from all responses via {'_id': 0} projections and pop('_id').
JWT_SECRET and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY loaded from env. Good.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (required for Expo runtime exposure). All API calls prefixed with /api. Correct.
Demo creds correctly seeded on startup and OTP mock returns '123456' as documented.
seed_data_creation: Created via backend: 1 TEST_Story (via /api/stories/create-from-text), 2 ephemeral test users (test_*@example.com, child_test_*@example.com), 1 TEST_Aarav child. No production data modified.
